gotchas: Guest booking, no login needed. Flow: search results -> 'View Rates' (opens a NEW TAB: wait_for_popup) -> Step 1 Select a Room ('Book From $..') -> Step 2 Select a Rate ('Select Flexible Rate for $..') -> Step 3 Payment and Guest Details, one page.

A search deep link works: /en/search/?query=<City%2C%20ST>&arrivalDate=YYYY-MM-DD&departureDate=YYYY-MM-DD&flexibleDates=false&numRooms=1&numAdults=1. Results take a few seconds to replace a 'Finding hotels...' placeholder.

Flexible rates are 'Pay when you stay': the card is a guarantee only ('No deposit required') and the form has NO security-code field, so the card leg is the number alone. Non-refundable and Honors Discount rates are also offered; the Honors Discount ones assume a member.

Card fields are inline (not in an iframe): number input[autocomplete=cc-number], expiry as two native selects select[autocomplete=cc-exp-month] (option labels like '02 Feb') and select[autocomplete=cc-exp-year]. Fill expiry before the number. There is no cardholder-name field.
'Join Hilton Honors for free' is PRE-CHECKED on the guest form; uncheck it, or the booking enrols the guest in Honors. Unchecking reveals no password field.

Country/Region is a native select defaulting to USA; State a native select (autocomplete address-level1); Address line 1 is an autocomplete combobox, so press Tab after the address block to close its suggestion list.
The order total is in the Reservation summary: 'dl:last-of-type dd' resolved to the stay total (taxes included) as an order.total hint. The final button is 'Book Reservation'.

Button and link names live in aria-label, so :has-text on the full accessible name does not match. Stable selectors: room button[aria-label^="Book From"][aria-label$="for <room name>"], and the Honors box is the only checked checkbox on the guest form (input[type=checkbox]:checked). Expiry month selects by value '02'.

The Non-refundable rate is prepaid and its payment form DOES carry a security code (input[name*=cvv i], labelled 'Security code') and a cardholder name ([autocomplete=cc-name]); pick it to exercise the full card leg. Flexible rates still show no CVV.

Since 2026-10 there is a 'Step 3 of 4 Customize Your Stay' page (room upgrade offer, special requests) before payment: click 'Continue to Payment'. Rate buttons' aria-label selectors ('Select Non-refundable for') did not match via CSS here; click by role/name.

route.note: Search deep link with query/arrivalDate/departureDate/numRooms=1/numAdults=1 (query is dropped from route urls); View Rates opens a new tab; Book From on the first room; Select Non-refundable (prepaid, shows a Security code field); Step 3 Customize Your Stay -> Continue to Payment.
